# cursor_environments (Data Source)

Lists the Cloud Agent environments the provider api_key can access, following nextCursor until it is absent. A page can be shorter than the limit. An environment updated during the walk moves to the front, so a later page can skip it or repeat another; a repeated environment is returned once, and the data source returns the walk it completed. For a key that is neither a team admin nor a service account, the API can also leave out team environments it has not finished checking. List items omit environmentJson and versionId.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_environments" "all" {}

locals {
  # Team environment names are unique, so they can key a map. name is null for unnamed environments.
  team_environment_ids_by_name = {
    for environment in data.cursor_environments.all.environments :
    environment.name => environment.id if environment.owner == "team" && environment.name != null
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments, sorted by id so that an update to one environment does not reorder the list. Empty when the key can access none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) environments.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the environment was created.
- `id` (String) Environment UUID.
- `name` (String) Display name. Null when the environment has no name.
- `owner` (String) team or personal.
- `repo_file_path` (String) Path of the configuration file in that repository. Null unless repo_file_url is set.
- `repo_file_url` (String) Repository that holds the configuration file. Set when the environment loads its configuration from a file in a repository, null otherwise.
- `repos` (Attributes List) Repositories in the environment, in the order the API returns them. Empty for an environment without repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments--repos))
- `updated_at` (String) When the environment was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--environments--repos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments.repos`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) Repository URL.
